default.name: Default
default.author: OpenWarlock
default.summary: The official version of the game.

versions.name: Remi’s Blood Debt
versions.author: @RemiFabre
versions.summary: Adds Blood Debt, a high-risk delayed-damage spell, and changes Boots to 20% / 40% / 60% movement speed.

versions.name: Ju’s Ricochet & Guardian Angel
versions.author: @Biousere
versions.summary: Ju's arsenal, v3: Ricochet, the secret Guardian Angel, the Dark Ball blackout and the Storm Ball. Plus craters (mines and meteors destroy the ground; permanent once anyone hits 10 kills) and a Switcheroo that grapples you to pillars and refunds 2 s on every landed hook.

versions.name: Trash Talk
versions.author: @RemiFabre
versions.summary: The warlocks comment on the fight: speech bubbles over their heads when they are hit, thrown, frozen, killed or upstaged. Lower case for the ordinary, ALL CAPS for the loud.

versions.name: Sharpshooter
versions.author: @RemiFabre
versions.summary: The fireball becomes a thin, very fast skillshot with a 50-unit range, and Frost stops slowing: its third stack freezes you where you stand and banks half the swallowed push for the next ability that hits you.

versions.name: Hold the Line
versions.author: @RemiFabre
versions.summary: Ember level 3 stops adding damage and lets you HOLD the fireball key to charge a bigger, heavier ball (five steps in 1.5 seconds, and holding too long loses the cast). Rush charges the same way, and a full-charge dash is invisible and unstoppable.

versions.name: Faker
versions.author: @RemiFabre
versions.summary: A difficulty above Extreme built around combos: four Faker-only arsenals (Hookstorm, Permafrost, Minefield, Galeforce) with chains like trap-under-feet → Switcheroo onto it → burst → lightning on the landing. Ships with a stand-still Runner dummy for sparring, and a Faker already seated in the lobby.

versions.name: Soul Harvest
versions.author: @FabienDanieau
versions.summary: One endless round: kills absorb one of the victim's spells, their items drop on the ground for anyone to grab, and the dead shop with catch-up gold before respawning. First to 15 kills. The lava closes slowly, and if the arena runs out, most kills wins.

versions.name: Genki
versions.author: @RemiFabre
versions.summary: A new spell in honor of the Genki-Dama: charge a ball above your head (3 damage per second, forever; the area grows like a filling pool), then fire one omega hit. At Terra-3 size it smashes pillars and flies on; five seconds later nothing reflects it. Any other cast or any direct hit drops the charge.
